fusions.name: Riverbank Snatch
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 12 water damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It grows 8% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Spin-Dry Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes a spray off your coat that deals 4 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 30% chance to be left [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggled Loose
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from the ally who needs it most. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Quite Caught
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
